Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Tasimetry: a quantitative memory transfer function
ideas.description: Stimulate cells across a matrix of AP-1-inducing doses and durations, wash out, wait defined intervals, then apply a deliberately sub-threshold second pulse and read out target induction by scRNA-seq or a live transcriptional reporter. Fitting response amplitude and latency against first-pulse strength and rest interval yields a memory gain curve and decay half-life, the minimal quantitative signature a true memory mechanism must show.

ideas.title: Epenthesis: motif insertion/deletion syntax library
ideas.description: Build an MPRA plus CRISPR knock-in library that inserts TRE/CRE motifs at varied copy number, spacing, and flanking context into naive and endogenous loci, and deletes them from memory-competent enhancers. Measuring which configurations retain accessibility and poised transcription after stimulus withdrawal separates motif presence from motif syntax as the actual carrier of memory.

ideas.title: Nucleosome hysteresis after stimulus washout
ideas.description: Run a washout time course combining ATAC-seq, Fos/Jun CUT&RUN, and high-resolution MNase footprinting to test whether enhancers remain nucleosome-depleted and H3K4me1/K27ac-marked after AP-1 occupancy falls below detection. Decoupling of accessibility from occupancy indicates a stored chromatin trace; synchronous loss argues AP-1 merely reports ongoing signaling.

ideas.title: Degron timing to separate establishment from maintenance
ideas.description: Tag endogenous Fos/Jun family members with auxin- or dTAG-inducible degrons and deplete them before stimulus, immediately after enhancer opening, and days into the rested state. Memory that survives acute late depletion but is erased during a defined consolidation window implies AP-1 writes to a stable substrate, whereas collapse at any time implies AP-1 is itself the store.

ideas.title: Clonal heritability and mitotic bookmarking
ideas.description: Use expressed lineage barcodes with a split-clone design to test whether re-challenge responsiveness after several divisions is clone-correlated rather than randomly distributed across the population. Pair this with live imaging and single-molecule residence-time measurements of Halo-tagged Fos/Jun during mitosis to test whether AP-1 physically bookmarks target enhancers through cell division.
